captions.detailed: A Maksutov-Cassegrain telescope assembly mounted on a compact alt-azimuth mount with a folding tripod. The telescope tube is a dark cylindrical body complete with an eyepiece, finder scope, and mounting rail. The alt-azimuth mount consists of a central dark grey hub that allows for panning and tilting. It is supported by three adjustable, light-colored aluminum legs with dark joints and rubber feet.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Maksutov-Cassegrain telescope on an alt-azimuth mount with a folding tripod. The model should feature a dark cylindrical telescope tube with a finder scope and eyepiece, a dual-axis rotating mount, and three aluminum tripod legs with dark plastic joint connectors.
captions.factory: Construct the telescope using a hierarchy of parts. Build the tripod base using cylinders for the center post and angled rectangular prisms or cylinders for the folding aluminum legs. Create the alt-azimuth mount using a series of cylindrical and box primitives to represent the panning base and the elevation arm. Model the optical tube assembly (OTA) as a main cylinder, adding smaller cylindrical extrusions for the eyepiece, finder scope, and focusing knob, then assemble them using revolute joints for azimuth and elevation rotation.
